title: How did 2 million people cross in one night?

beats.text: Could two million people cross overnight?
beats.scene: Painted huge crowd of silhouettes streaming across a seabed between towering water walls at night. Overlay: counter 2,000,000.

beats.text: Exodus counts six hundred thousand men on foot.
beats.scene: Long line of travellers with bundles in a desert at dusk. Overlay: counter 600,000.

beats.text: Add women and children, and the traditional estimate is about two million.
beats.scene: Families walking with sheep and carts at golden hour. Overlay: counter about 2,000,000.

beats.text: Fill a stadium of eighty thousand. Do it twenty-five times.
beats.scene: Packed stadium at night seen from above, camera rising. Overlay: counter x25.

beats.text: Ten abreast, the column stretches about two hundred kilometres.
beats.scene: Endless column of silhouettes marching on a narrow causeway toward the horizon. Overlay: scale bar 200 km.

beats.text: At walking pace that takes two days, not one night.
beats.scene: Moonlit shoreline, a few travellers glancing back, camera drifting. Overlay: timer counting past 48 hours.

beats.text: A thousand abreast would need a front one kilometre wide.
beats.scene: Wide shallow strait with a vast crowd spread across it. Overlay: scale bar 1 km.

beats.text: So some scholars read 'elef' as clans, not thousands.
beats.scene: Tribal families gathered around tents at dusk. Overlay: label compare 600 clans vs 600,000.

beats.text: That could mean a few thousand people, which changes everything.
beats.scene: Small band of travellers silhouetted at the water's edge. Overlay: counter shrinking to a few thousand.

beats.text: And Yam Suph means 'Sea of Reeds', not necessarily the Red Sea.
beats.scene: Papyrus reeds along a marshy shallow lake at sunrise. Overlay: compare map pin shift, no text in image.

beats.text: Not proven: where they crossed is still unknown.
beats.scene: Empty shoreline in grey dawn with footprints fading. Overlay: question mark badge.

beats.text: So was it two million or a small band?
beats.scene: Silhouettes crossing between walls of water at night. Overlay: choice tags A two million / B small band.

youtube.title: How Did 2 Million Cross the Red Sea? #shorts
youtube.description:
Exodus 12:37 counts 600,000 men on foot. How would that many cross in one night? We run the numbers.
The size of the crowd and the sea itself are debated, not proven.
#Exodus #RedSea #Bible #BibleHistory
